convert_nlc_to_nchw: convert a PyTorch tensor from NLC shape to NCHW shape using nlc_to_nchw function
convert_nchw_to_nlc: convert a PyTorch tensor from NCHW shape to NLC shape using nchw_to_nlc function
create_adaptive_padding: create an AdaptivePadding module to pad tensors with same or corner padding modes
build_patch_embed: build a PatchEmbed module to convert image tensors into patch embeddings for transformer models
build_patch_merging: build a PatchMerging module to merge patch feature maps using nn.Unfold for spatial downsampling
